name: Several inputs converging on a few scores
useWhen: Three or four scores on a common scale, shown as derived from named inputs rather than asserted.

focal.note: The scores dominate, as they should — but all four equally, because none of them is the answer on its own.

replacesNote: stats-v3 does proportional bubbles for wide ranges; this does equal discs for narrow ones. They are not substitutes.

deviations.source: SELECCION-25-indice.md says to size diameters by the square root of the value
deviations.why: Right instinct, wrong slide. Square-root sizing makes AREA read as magnitude across orders of magnitude; across 85-99 it produces a 7.6% difference that is invisible as data and visible as sloppiness, and it implies the discs are a chart when they are four printed scores. Recorded rather than silently ignored.
